question: Do generated mouths encode the natural phonetic categories at the original time, and do historical head-minus-RMS SyncNet changes coincide with that functional response? This is seen-DEV exploratory measurement, not human accuracy or candidate tuning.
scope: Exactly the8 fixed utterances/4 speakers/3models/2arms/3seeds/144 existing trajectories. No new alignments, cohort expansion, renders, extraction, native encoder, score, API, training, dependencies or implementation tests.

vowel_rounding_proxy.boundary: width is an indirect narrowing proxy and correlated with vowel height; never label it exact lip roundness or accuracy

bilabial_place_closure_proxy.reason: Only1 speaker has both classes under frozen >=2 core frames; retain failed support, no threshold/map/cohort adjustment

geometry_definition: IPD = distance between eye landmarks33/263; similarity-normalized aperture is distance13/14; width is bbox x extent over pinned31 mouth points. Area is width*height, not lip contour; no raw landmarks or real video GT.

time_and_support.primary: Use all frozen SUPPORTED_TOKEN core indices from support inventory and its6-row common valid timestamps per model/utterance. Keep exact original j/25. Restrict any normalization/control timestamps to [0, original natural sample_count/16000).
time_and_support.standardization: Per row and variable, calculate arithmetic mean and population SD (ddof0) over all6-row-common valid original-natural-time frames; z=(value-mean)/SD. SD<=1e-8 IPD marks standardized metric UNMEASURABLE, never alternate normalization. Preserve raw-unit contrast and SD to show scale.
time_and_support.time_controls: Secondary fixed offsets -4 and+4 frames (-/+160ms), no wrap/warp/reindexing. Build a single Sshift subset of original token core centers having zero/negative/positive-shift valid frames in ALL6 rows and original natural audio duration. Require>=2 remaining centers/token. Recompute zero and shifted contrasts on that SAME Sshift support. Do not substitute primary S0 with Sshift. Report shifted frames outside original phone fraction and all support losses.
time_and_support.specificity: H = contrast_zero_on_Sshift - (contrast_minus4 + contrast_plus4)/2. Positive H is correct-time specificity in this proxy; absence does not assert human inaccuracy.
time_and_support.shift_support: Require>=3 speakers with both classes on Sshift to summarize a model/attribute temporal-specificity result; otherwise label it UNSUPPORTED and retain per-speaker descriptive values.

reduction: For each row: mean core values per token; token-equal within exact tone-stripped base phone per utterance; basephone-equal within high/low class. Average3 seeds within utterance/method/class, then utterance-equal within speaker/method/class (only utterances with that class), then signed high/low contrast. Use exactly identical supports for the two methods. Report class utterance/token/frame counts and row IDs. Candidate delta=head-RMS. Speaker is unit, never seed/token/frame.
motion_secondary: Within each selected primary token core compute raw aperture speed RMS from differences of adjacent consecutive valid frames/0.04s; if no adjacent pair mark unavailable. Reduce by same token/phone/utterance/seed/speaker class hierarchy. Report change descriptively, without a larger/smaller-is-better gate. Do not read raw video or redo trajectory extraction.
baseline_coordinate_checks: For each supported attribute/model, report RMS baseline signed standardized contrast and Sshift specificity speaker values. A descriptive task-related baseline coordinate requires>=3 speakers,>=ceil(2n/3) positive speaker values and positive median, independently for contrast and specificity. Do not change sign/map/normalizer after outcomes. This check is independent of head benefit and admits no GPU candidate.
score_comparison: After motion definitions are frozen, read only existing hash-bound canonical scalar scores by matching row_id. Verify original natural PCM/mux equality and25fps clock fields from existing records; no raw SyncNet recalculation. For each model/attribute use the union of utterances contributing supported high/low primary tokens, average seeds then utterances then speaker. Report full Cbest/B/Dmin/D0/lag and head-RMS alongside motion; guard20 secondary. Show per-speaker sign table, no pooled-token/seed p-values, no correlation significance or model pooling. Full8-utterance cohort scores may be separately labelled descriptive.
progression: No automatic next GPU/head admission. All models/attributes/statuses and both positive/negative outcomes must be reported. Preserve old v4 head failure on full DEV, all prior native/physical stop gates and sealed confirmation boundaries. Root chooses a new bounded hypothesis after one actual-artifact QA.
execution_gate: Original Luna prepares one small NumPy source using existing pinned support/records and explicit UTF-8. ROOT reads source once before effect execution. Do not read motion magnitudes or score values during source preparation/selection.
